exclusions: All Part 2 text and all extracted verbatim textbook page files have been removed from this branch's curriculum corpus.

limitations: Difficulty levels in curriculum-intelligence-part1.json are provisional educational estimates from topic type and curriculum structure; they are not official Ministry difficulty labels.
Student self-rating and assessment history take precedence over provisional curriculum estimates.
English unit page spans are verified at unit level only; individual English topic page spans and difficulty remain unknown.
Italian has two unit names only until its original Part 1 PDF is provided.
Arabic and History page ranges derive from the official tables of contents; exact page body content is not stored.

generalEgyptianSchoolSystem.law: Education Law 139/1981 as amended by Law 169/2025

assessment.firstMonthlyExamScope: Only material taught from the start of the school year through the end of the first month

productRules: A full-year index is not evidence that a teacher has already taught every listed lesson.
A monthly assessment covers taught content for that assessment period, not the full-year syllabus.
Teacher progress must be reported or verified separately; date-based pacing is only an estimate.
Preparatory certificate schedules must be treated as governorate-specific rather than nationwide-identical.

curriculumCatalogCoverage.note: This catalog stores derived lesson titles and curriculum relationships only. It does not store full textbook page text. Textbook page-body retrieval remains separately limited to the indexed Part 1 sources listed under books.
